decisions.why: Electric, active user, manual, and tilt-in-space wheelchairs including Zippie Youngster, ZIPPIE Simba, Little Wave FLIP and Rea Dahlia are specialist seating for mobility (rehab:chair).
Care chairs, riser recliners, clinician chairs, treatment chairs, and bariatric seating including Circulo Bari Chair and QuickCare Pro Lie-Flat Chair are clinical furniture (handling:furniture).
Division includes Air Transfer Mattress (handling:mattress), Slide Sheets (handling:slide), and other moving/handling equipment spanning multiple handling categories.
Products include profiling bed grab rails (handling:bed) and mattress protectors/overlays (handling:mattress), spanning bed and mattress categories.
